StubCatalogItemTraits.description: Whether the catalog item is experiencing issues which may cause its data to be unavailable

StubCatalogItemTraits.description: The description of the catalog item. Markdown and HTML may be used.

StubCatalogItemTraits.name: hideDefaultDescription

StubCatalogItemTraits.name: nameInCatalog

StubCatalogItemTraits.description: An array of section titles defining the display order of info sections. If this property is not defined, {@link DataPreviewSections}'s DEFAULT_SECTION_ORDER is used

StubCatalogItemTraits.name: isOpenInWorkbench
StubCatalogItemTraits.description: Whether the item in the workbench open or collapsed.

StubCatalogItemTraits.name: shortReport
StubCatalogItemTraits.description: A short report to show on the now viewing tab.

StubCatalogItemTraits.name: shortReportSections
StubCatalogItemTraits.description: A list of collapsible sections of the short report

StubCatalogItemTraits.name: hideSource
StubCatalogItemTraits.description: Indicates that the source of this data should be hidden from the UI (obviously this isn't super-secure as you can just look at the network requests).

StubCatalogItemTraits.name: metadataUrls
StubCatalogItemTraits.description: Metadata URLs to show in data catalog.

StubCatalogItemTraits.name: dataUrls
StubCatalogItemTraits.description: Data URLs to show in data catalog.

StubCatalogItemTraits.name: dataCustodian
StubCatalogItemTraits.description: Gets or sets a description of the custodian of this data item.

StubCatalogItemTraits.name: modelDimensions
StubCatalogItemTraits.description: This provides ability to set model JSON through SelectableDimensions (a dropdown). When an option is selected, the value property will be used to call updateModelFromJson(). All string properties support Mustache templates (with the catalog member as context)

StubCatalogItemTraits.name: disableAboutData
StubCatalogItemTraits.description: Disables the 'About Data' button in the workbench.

StubCatalogItemTraits.name: shareable
StubCatalogItemTraits.description: True (default) if this catalog member may be included in share links. False to exclude it from share links.

StubCatalogItemTraits.name: workbenchControlFlags
StubCatalogItemTraits.description: Flags for enabling or disabling workbench controls.

InfoSectionTraits.name: content

InfoSectionTraits.name: contentAsObject
InfoSectionTraits.description: The content of the section which is a JSON object. Set this property to null to remove this section entirely.

InfoSectionTraits.name: show
InfoSectionTraits.description: Indicates if this info section showing (not collapsed).

ShortReportTraits.name: show
ShortReportTraits.description: Indicates if this short report section showing.

MetadataUrlTraits.description: The metadata URL of the file or service.

MetadataUrlTraits.name: title
MetadataUrlTraits.description: Title used for metadata URL button.

DataUrlTraits.name: type
DataUrlTraits.description:
Type of data URL. This value will be used to provide context or instruction on how to use the data URL. For example wcs will provide a link to WCS docs.
Current supported values are:
- wfs = A Web Feature Service (WFS) base URL
- wcs = A Web Coverage Service (WCS) base URL
- wfs-complete = A complete, ready-to-use link to download features from a WCS server
-  wcs-complete = A complete, ready-to-use link to download features from a WFS server
-  direct = Direct URL to dataset (this is the default if no type is specified)
-  none = Hide data URL
